# App Store Rank Tracker

> Track an ios app's app store chart rank, rating, rating count and version changes.

- Actor: data_foundry/aso-app-rank-tracker
- URL: https://apify.com/data_foundry/aso-app-rank-tracker
- Publisher: Data Foundry (https://apify.com/data_foundry)
- Category: ASO / monitoring
- Pricing: $0.50 per 1,000 apps tracked; pay per event, no subscription, failures not billed
- Input: App Store IDs with optional country
- Output: rank, rating and version per app with deltas
- Run: apify call data_foundry/aso-app-rank-tracker
- API: POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/data_foundry~aso-app-rank-tracker/runs
- More actors: https://apify.com/data_foundry
